rationale: Drops the Post, ChannelToken, ScheduledGeneration and WorkerHeartbeat tables and their enums in a migration, removes the publish_post MCP/ACP capability, and removes the HOLD gate in the publish path, which changes persisted data shape and removes a capability other surfaces assume.

signals.blast_radius: About 90 files across schema, migrations, worker loops, MCP/ACP routes, analytics catalogue, Insights, draft and library UI, the /team channels section, E2E suites and docs
signals.unresolved: Whether Postgres DraftStatus and PostGenerationAction enum values are rebuilt or left unused, and whether Download keeps storing PNGs in BUCKET_EXPORTS (the second question changes what is stored)
signals.irreversibility: Dropping tables and enums with migrated data is not a git revert, and it deletes encrypted social channel tokens (ChannelToken) and removes the HOLD gate, so restoring them needs a new migration and re-entry of credentials
